behavior: AC1: iptables backend, policy ACCEPT, rule present: check and setup report manual naming the policy and the DROP/firewall fix, firewall_ok false
AC2: iptables backend, policy ACCEPT, rule absent: setup adds the scoped rule, reports manual, and runs no iptables -P
AC3: policy DROP, the ufw backend, or an already unverified/failed step keep their outcomes
AC4: e2e on the Linux VM: default-ACCEPT iptables guest is manual with firewall_ok false; under DROP the iptables cases pass
